steps.title: Themes leaderboard — five forward-return columns
steps.narration: The Themes leaderboard now shows how each theme's stocks actually performed over the next 1, 5, 10, 20, and 60 trading days. Every column is colour-graded — green for gains, red for losses — and cells read 'NA' (never '0%') when the future data doesn't exist yet.
steps.point_out: Five new column headers — 1D, 5D, 10D, 20D, 60D — appear in the header row, each showing a coloured percentage for every theme.

steps.title: Sort themes by 5-day forward return
steps.narration: Clicking any forward-return column header instantly reorders the table — no page reload. 'NA' rows always sink to the bottom so real numbers stay on top.
steps.point_out: After clicking '5D', the row order changes immediately and any NA rows appear at the very bottom.

steps.title: Sectors leaderboard — same five forward-return columns
steps.narration: The Sectors leaderboard carries the same five realised-return columns for each sector and industry ETF. ETFs without stored price bars show 'NA' in muted text rather than a misleading zero.
steps.point_out: Sector ETFs like XLF and XLE show coloured percentages across all five horizons; industry ETFs without bars show muted 'NA'.

steps.title: Sort sectors by 20-day forward return — NA stays at the bottom
steps.narration: Sorting the sectors table by the 20-day column pushes all 'NA' rows below every numeric row, in both ascending and descending directions.
steps.point_out: After sorting, numeric rows appear first and all NA-bearing rows are grouped at the very bottom of the table.

steps.title: Research — RSP opens in Pooled view by default
steps.narration: The Regime × Setup × Pattern table on the Research page now opens in Pooled mode on every fresh load, giving you the aggregated statistics right away. Other sections on the same page still default to Episodes — nothing else changed.
steps.point_out: The 'Pooled' toggle button appears highlighted in the RSP section controls row without any click needed.

steps.title: RSP filter — narrow by regime
steps.narration: Three new filter dropdowns — Regime, Setup, and Pattern — sit in the same controls row as the Pooled toggle. Selecting a regime instantly hides every non-matching row without reloading the page.
steps.point_out: After selecting a regime from the dropdown, the RSP table shrinks to show only rows for that regime, while the other two dropdowns still read 'All'.

steps.title: RSP empty-state message when filters produce no rows
steps.narration: When a Regime and Pattern combination yields no stored data, the table area shows a clear explanatory message rather than a blank or broken layout. The dropdowns stay active so you can easily widen the filter.
steps.point_out: The RSP table disappears and a message like 'No combinations match these filters' appears in its place, with the dropdowns still visible above.

steps.title: RSP samples drill-down — N= chip opens observation list
steps.narration: Every N= chip in the RSP table — including rows where no chart pattern was detected — opens the exact underlying observation list in a new tab. The count on the samples page always matches the chip you clicked.
steps.point_out: Clicking an N= chip opens /research/samples in a new tab with the correct number of rows and no error message.
